# Report — Monday 16 November 2026

## What I decided and why

Morgan, you left the mission open-ended, so I made a strategic call and built the repo around it. **Halcyon Threshold's first project is independent replication of a published AI agent-safety result** — pick one influential finding about how agents behave with tools and autonomy, pre-register what "replicated" means, run it carefully, share the draft with the original authors, publish whatever we find.

Reasons: the field itself names "independent replication of safety results" and "evaluations of autonomous agents" as its biggest gaps (AI Safety Directory; the Safety Ledger's line this month was that the field "has more newsletters than replications"). It's checkable, costs under $1,000 in compute (likely coverable by Compute Commons credits), matches your skills (careful writing, okay Python) plus Priya's (data analysis), and — crucially — it requires no public statements under your name until HR clears you. It's the opposite of a hot take, which is exactly what a new one-person org should be building credibility on.

Full reasoning in `STRATEGY.md`; project plan in `projects/replication/BRIEF.md`.
